basics.name: Rogério Araújo
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: with 6+ years of experience designing and building scalable consumer products across mobile, web, and backend platforms. Currently developing sportsbook and iGaming systems serving 2M+ users at Pitaco (formerly Rei do Pitaco). Experienced in distributed systems, platform engineering, SQL/NoSQL databases, observability, and experimentation. Technical foundation in TypeScript/JavaScript, Flutter, React/Next.js, Rust, and Node.js. Passionate about solving complex technical problems and designing maintainable software.
